meta.name: Classic Movies Channel
meta.description:
There’s a reason some movies are called “classics. Watch a curated collection of some of the greatest films and brightest stars of Hollywood’s golden era on Pluto TV’s Classic Movies Channel.

Shows: The Thomas Crown Affair, The Reivers, It! The Terror From Beyond Space, The Masque of the Red Death, The Rat Race
Available on: Pluto TV
